data.name: Super Sanctum TD
data.detailed_description:
Super Sanctum TD is a retro-styled Tower Defense game that focuses on strategy, customization and replayability. Build advanced mazes and construct powerful towers to prevent alien hordes from reaching the Core! When the aliens swarm your maze and everything seems lost, use active abilities like Air Strike and Freeze to tilt the battlefield to your advantage!

Strategy and skill are leading principles of Super Sanctum TD. Carefully choose your loadout of towers and active abilities before each level to make sure you can handle everything that will be thrown at you. Each battle is rewarded depending on your performance, and you can use these rewards to gain access to Perks that let you tweak and specialize your strategies even more!

  • Carefully plan your maze to master the game on all difficulties.
  • Towers like Gatling, Flamer and the Automatic Crowd Pummeler, all with their own individual strengths.
  • Intercept enemies from reaching the Cores with active abilities like Smart Bomb and Gravity Shift!
  • Vast perk system that lets you specialize specific towers, abilities, and more!
  • Prove yourself as the ultimate Core defender by defeating the game on all difficulties and game modes.
  • Square up against the best for a spot on the leaderboard by putting your deadliest strategies to the test in Survival Mode!

Super Sanctum TD has recently recieved a major overhaul with a revamped UI, new perk system and rebalanced gameplay!

reviews.review:
SUPER SANCTUM TD? MORE LIKE SUPER SANCTUM GRINDING THERAPY, MOTHERFUCKER!

Listen up, you pixelated tower-defense enthusiasts. I fucking LOVE tower-defense games. Give me some towers, a horde of ugly bastards marching toward my base, and enough strategic options to make a military general develop erectile dysfunction, and I’m a happy man. And to be fair, Super Sanctum TD doesn’t look half bad. Sure, the retro graphics make it look like someone excavated a gaming console from the 1970s and forced it to run on a calculator screen, but hey, it’s only 100 MB. Tiny game, tiny screen, tiny file size. What could possibly go wrong? 

OH, EVERYTHING. EVERYTHING WENT WRONG.

The biggest problem with this game is that its progression system was apparently designed by someone who believes that fun is a privilege reserved for people who have suffered enough. You see, the game throws increasingly difficult enemies at you while keeping the tools you need to deal with them locked behind an XP grind so fucking slow that a tortoise could finish a PhD, retire, raise three generations of tortoises, and die peacefully before you unlock your next useful ability. Imagine facing a bunch of monsters that are best handled with the Soft Field perk. Sounds reasonable, right? Except you need to reach LEVEL 20 to unlock the fucking thing. 

LEVEL. FUCKING. TWENTY.

Meanwhile, the game is sitting there at level 12, laughing at you like a sadistic little shit while you replay the same goddamn level approximately 60 times just to squeeze out enough XP to make the tiniest amount of progress. And don't even get me started on the skills and towers. Those are locked behind the same godforsaken progression system. The game keeps introducing problems that require specific tools, then hides those tools behind hours of grinding. 

THAT'S NOT STRATEGIC DIFFICULTY, YOU PIXELATED ASSHOLE. THAT'S A FUCKING HOSTAGE SITUATION.

A tower-defense game should let you experiment with different towers, perks, and strategies. That's the entire goddamn appeal! You try something, get your ass kicked, adjust your strategy, and come back stronger. But here? Your strategic freedom has been stuffed into a locker, duct-taped to the ceiling, and guarded by a level-20 bouncer who won't let you in because your XP balance is insufficient. And the most infuriating part? The further you progress, the slower everything becomes. Getting from level 12 to 13 already feels like pushing a shopping cart uphill through wet cement, and the game expects you to keep doing this while knowing that some of the most useful abilities are still miles away. 

WHO DESIGNED THIS PROGRESSION SYSTEM? A FUCKING BANK?

I came here to defend a base, not take out a mortgage on my own entertainment. Look, I can tolerate retro graphics. I can tolerate difficult enemies. I can even tolerate getting absolutely violated by a boss so hard that I need to sit in a dark room and reconsider my life choices. What I cannot tolerate is a game deliberately restricting my tactical options while demanding that I replay the same content until my soul leaves my body and files a missing-person report. There are plenty of other tower-defense games that manage to be challenging without turning progression into a second fucking job. Unfortunately, Super Sanctum TD seems to believe that making players grind for basic strategic options is a substitute for good game design. 

My verdict? Skip this one unless your idea of entertainment is replaying the same level until your controller starts whispering, “Please, just let me die.”

I'll stick with the original Sanctum duology, thank you very much. At least that game understands that players want to have fun, not spend their evenings submitting an XP application to the Department of Fucking Tower Defense.

The towers are fine. The grind can go fuck itself.
